KPlugin.Description: Android-style 3-finger touchpad recents: swipe up to open the task switcher and hold it, left/right to cycle, then lift to switch after a short idle delay. Also starts a sticky 4-finger left-button drag that hands off to native one-finger movement and ends with a one-finger tap, shows the desktop, and switches apps. Requires InputActions; one setting turns the gestures on or off.
KPlugin.Name: Windows-Style Touchpad Gestures
